article.title: Registering officer not liable for thing bona fide done or refused in his official capacity.
article.content: No registering officer shall be liable to any suit, claim or demand by reason of anything in good faith done or refused in his official capacity.
article.html:
86Registering officer not liable for thing bona fide done or refused in his official capacity.

Section 86 · Part XV · page 55 of the Act

No registering officer shall be liable to any suit, claim or demand by reason of anything in good faith done or refused in his official capacity.
